verdict.rationale: RevenueCat offers an official MCP server for AI assistants (revenuecat-docs-9) and Rico, an assistant that answers plain-language MRR questions directly from platform data (revenuecat-docs-10, revenuecat-docs-24). Per-customer purchase and subscription data is available through CustomerInfo and the secret-key REST API (revenuecat-docs-3, revenuecat-docs-5, revenuecat-docs-15, revenuecat-docs-19). However, the MCP server is described in terms of configuration (products, entitlements), not billing-state queries, so a user's own agent querying metrics is only implied. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server or AI Toolkit exposes MRR and metrics queries to an external agent; delinquent or billing-issue account lookup; an upcoming-renewals query; customer invoice retrieval; hands-on corroboration.
